bad.post: $PRISM is about to explode and smart money is positioning for the next leg up. Hidden accumulation is building under the surface while the price grinds toward the top of its range. The tape says this breakout is only getting started, and the volume will follow once the move begins. This is the kind of setup that rewards those who spot it early.
bad.why: Hype and forbidden phrases: 'smart money', 'hidden accumulation', 'under the surface', 'the tape says'.

bad.post: $PRISM is pushing toward the top of its range on strong volume, so buy now before it breaks out. The token is gaining momentum, the setup looks ready, and waiting means chasing a higher price later. Get in while it is still near $4.92 and let the breakout carry the position. This entry will not stay cheap for long.
bad.why: Explicit buy advice: tells readers to buy now before the breakout.

good.post: $PRISM sits at $4.92, near the top of its 24-hour range, after gaining 13.8% on $58.6M volume, about 2.9x the $20.2M average. The move ran ahead of participation in the final hours, and volume faded even as price pushed higher. A stretched setup like this can keep running, but the tape is showing less conviction at the top than at the start. The range edge is where the move gets harder to read.
good.why: Caution: price near the range top while volume faded late in the move.

good.post: $COBALT climbed 9.7% to $2.61, yet volume fell to $7.4M, below the $11.8M average, and the token now trades within 2% of its 24-hour high. Price pushed up while participation thinned, which is a combination worth noting rather than celebrating. The move may continue, but the evidence behind it is getting lighter. A thin push near the top of the range deserves caution, not excitement.
good.why: Caution: price up 9.7% on thinning volume near the range high.

good.post: $JASPER gained 15.2% in two sessions, trading $73.1M against a $28.4M average, and now sits 4% below its 24-hour high of $1.86. The pace of the move has outrun the volume supporting it, and the last session closed well off its peak. Stretched moves can stretch further, but the tape is starting to show the strain. The setup looks tired at these levels, even if the price itself has not turned yet.
good.why: Caution: a 15.2% two-session move outrunning its volume, closing off the peak.
